notes.title: We updated our demo!
notes.content:
[h1]We updated our demo!
[/h1]
Hello, everyone!
Thank you for playing our demo!
Thanks to your feedback, we always know what can be improved.
[b]We have updated our demo:
[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added the Spanish language.
[*] Worked on the text.
[*] Updated the island model.
[*] Added new animations.
[/olist]
We hope you'll enjoy the update!
